name: cry_jynx
note: the longest cry sample (23524 samples, 2.24 s), still over before the 140-tick EOT; no cry sample loops

name: cry_jynx_faint
note: Cry_Jynx at CRY_MODE_FAINT's pitch 14440 (TIE key 56, TUNE 116): the sample would run 2.75 s, so it is still sounding at the 140-tick EOT -- the first cry whose ply_endtie finds a chained channel holding the key (the measured +28) and whose release-0 cut is audible; ply_fine then unlinks the live channel

name: cry_bulbasaur_howl
note: Cry_Bulbasaur at CRY_MODE_HIGH_PITCH's pitch 15800 (TIE key 62, TUNE 28; Howl's pitch without its chorus / length / release) panned hard right (pan 63 as the game's opponent side, PAN byte 0x7F): a non-zero pan through ChnVolSetAsm

name: cry_pidgey_quiet
note: Cry_Pidgey at volume 90 (CRY_MODE_ENCOUNTER / HIGH_PITCH's value, VOL byte 0x5A) at the default pitch and pan

name: cry_jynx_faint_full
note: Cry_Jynx with CRY_MODE_FAINT complete (pitch 14440, length 140, release 200; the mode sets no chorus): the twin of cry_jynx_faint whose EOT releases the still-sounding channel instead of cutting it -- the first release tail on a DPCM channel in the corpus (envelope 255 * 200 >> 8 per frame from the EOT on frame 143, the channel stopped on frame 161 when the product reaches 0); ply_fine unlinks the releasing channel

name: cry_wailord_doubles
note: Cry_Wailord with CRY_MODE_DOUBLES (length 20, release 225, pitch 15360; the mode sets no chorus): the 1.98 s sample cut by the EOT at tick 20 (frame 23) with the slowest release, 30 release frames to the channel's stop on frame 53

name: cry_pidgey_roar2
note: Cry_Pidgey with CRY_MODE_ROAR_2 (length 60, release 225, pitch 15616 = TIE key 61; the mode sets no chorus): the 0.17 s sample has ended long before tick 60 (the unlink tick on frame 14), so the EOT on frame 63 finds an empty chain and only the xWAIT length changes against cry_pidgey; the xRELE byte reaches no channel
